tagline: 尼康数码单反相机，2003 年发布
description: 尼康于2003年推出的数码单反相机。配备Interchangeable, Nikon F-mount。快门速度Electromagnetically controlled vertical-travel focal-plane shutter。

specs.传感器: 23.3 mm × 15.5 mm JFET-LBCAST; 4.26 million total pixels, 1.5× Crop factor Nikon DX format
specs.曝光测光: 3D Color Matrix; EV 0-20 at ISO 100 equivalent with f/1.4 lens (EV 2-20 with Spot Metering)
specs.取景器: Optical-type fixed eye-level pentaprism, 100% frame coverage, 0.86× magnification
specs.屏幕: 2.5-in., 211,200-dot, low-temp. polysilicon TFT LCD with white LED backlighting
specs.重量: Approx. without battery and storage media, 157.5 mm × 149.5 mm × 85.5 mm (6.2 in × 5.9 in × 3.4 in)
